reviews.title: HCP —-> Think… then fix it. My criticism is constructive and valid!
reviews.text:
Overall, it’s a good app, however: It causes a lot of problems due to HCP design team being stubborn. 
A fair number of companies operate in RURAL areas- often there is little to no cell service! 
1. When I arrive to the job and press ‘start my time’… just LOG my start time in the app, don’t time out on me and make it look like I didn’t start my job On Time! (When I do finally have cell service, you can update the system!) <— not difficult to design in your app. 

2. Great, I finished my job… (sometimes it will let me start, but not finish a job… which assigns more time to the job and makes it look like I spent too much time on the job. AGAIN, same as point number 1. Just log it on my app and update the server when I do have cell service. 

3. Yes, my job is finished… time to go to the next job. I pull up my schedule and it’s blank… WHY?!
Because I have little to no cell service, HCP, in their infinite wisdom made all my jobs disappear!! Good luck figuring out where to go for your next job!!! 
AGAIN, if I have little to no cell service, don’t make my jobs disappear in an attempt to update my schedule. My jobs should ALWAYS be visible!!
This is also easy to design. 
BTW, HCP does this in case there a change in your schedule, but it’s worse to have all my jobs disappear than to have a schedule change not noted. It just doesn’t work good in Rural areas.

reviews.title: Great for HVAC Companies!
reviews.text:
We’ve been using Housecall Pro since starting our HVAC business over two years ago, and it has become a core part of our daily operations.

What we appreciate most is that the platform continues to improve. The team consistently releases updates that make the software more efficient for both business owners and customers. Some of the recent additions have been true game changers for us.

The ability to accept tap-to-pay directly from a mobile phone has made collecting payments faster and more convenient. The Wisetack financing integration has also been fantastic, allowing us to offer financing options to customers without adding extra complexity to our process. Another feature we love is the ability to manage our price book directly from the mobile app, which gives us much more flexibility when we’re in the field.

As a small HVAC company, we’ve found Housecall Pro to be one of the most valuable tools we’ve invested in. Like many users, we’ve occasionally encountered features or workflows that required some learning, but we’ve found that creating a test customer and trying things firsthand is often the best way to understand exactly how a feature works and how it impacts the customer experience.

Overall, Housecall Pro has helped us operate more professionally, streamline our processes, and better serve our customers. We highly recommend it to other home service businesses.

This is just one example of manyyyy that does not make any sense in the work flow scheme. The whole system is messy as if someone designing this program never actually used it themselves. There are lots of different avenues to create estimates, jobs, invoices and each avenue has different restrictions as far as scheduling and sending estimates and it’s so confusing to know what route you’re supposed to take. If you do get lucky and click the right progression of buttons, good luck to you because you will never remember what you just did. My husband and I are in our 30s and very familiar with technology. We have both coded and created websites and still, this software makes no logical sense. With it being around since 2013 I thought it would be so much further along with basic functions. We wanted this to work SO BADLY because we are drowning with an overflow of customers in our business and HCP does really well in some things, but we just don’t have the time to figure out this labyrinth. Most people going out to do house calls are mobile and are using their mobile phones and iPads so why is this system so lacking in the mobile version? It doesn’t make any sense.

reviews.title: Major Update Broke Important Features We Use Daily
reviews.text:
I’ve been a loyal Housecall Pro customer for around 5 years, but after the major update about a month ago, the platform became significantly worse for our business operations.

This review is not about small bugs. These are core operational problems that still have not been fixed.

1. Deposit option disappeared
    We used the deposit feature constantly in our daily workflow, especially for parts ordering and customer approvals. After the update, this functionality became limited or disappeared in ways that disrupted our process completely. For a field service company, this is a critical feature.
2. Reporting became much worse
    After the update, many important reporting columns and data views disappeared. Reporting is one of the most important parts of managing a service business, and now it feels incomplete and unprofessional compared to before. We lost visibility into information we relied on every day.
3. Messaging/phone system is still broken
    This has been a major issue for a long time and still has not been resolved.

We use multiple tracking phone numbers through Housecall Pro for Yelp, Google, and other lead sources. When a customer calls us, we manually create their profile and communicate with them through the customer account inside Housecall Pro.

The problem is:
sometimes customer replies come into a completely different message window, even though it’s the same customer and same phone number.

So our team sends messages from the customer profile thread, but customer responses appear in another separate empty thread. This creates confusion, missed communication, duplicate conversations, and looks extremely unprofessional to both our office staff and customers.

We already complained about this issue multiple times last year and this year, but nothing meaningful has changed.

Honestly, it feels like these updates were released without properly thinking about real service businesses that rely on this software every day.

Very disappointing experience lately.
1 star until these issues are properly addressed.

reviews.title: Lots of good, and lots of bad
reviews.text:
I’ve been using house call pro now for over two years and while it has been SUPER helpful in managing all aspects of my business, it also has some major flaws that never seem to be addressed no matter how much I report them to the developers. I have been on so many conversations with support on the blue chat bubble I can’t even count them all. The staff is dismissive, unhelpful, and always treat me like I don’t matter. I have so much invested in Housecall Pro that I wouldn’t have expected to be treated this way. 

For example we had online booking setup with a link from Housecall Pro where clients can click a link from our website and see our services and schedule on Housecall Pro. We had selected to only allow people to book if they pay a deposit. Well come to find out we had many fake bookings and somehow they were able to bypass our deposit requirement. When I reached out to HCP support and demonstrated the issue, they investigated and finally after spending a few hours trying to figure out what was going on, they inform it its by design and not a flaw. They want people to be able to book and then you have to harass them yourself to get their payment info once they book. 

Today I followed up on another an issue/ticket after being given a one month trial of an add on called Pipeline. Well come to find out they did a bate and switch on me and kept charging me for a free one month trial. When I refuted the charges with the associate on the chat support, they simply said it should have been implied that I was signing up for a monthly service and that I would have to cancel it myself after a month. Very very misleading and they gave NO grace, no understanding no willingness to take responsibility for misleading me. I will be looking for a new CRM soon to say the least.

reviews.title: They are Scammers- DO NOT USE
reviews.text:
I am very disappointed, bad company to deal with; it’s actually a scam.
As a building contractor,  I was looking for an app to manage my business. I found “HOUSECALL PRO” and I called them;  they offered me a first month rate of $25 with full access.  I input some of my clients info and started using the app.  As I used it, I learned that all the important features are disabled, such as printing invoices. Etc. When I first spoke to Customer Service for the app, I told them that if it worked for me, then I’ll continue my subscription.  If not,  I’ll cancel.  After a few days without the ability to print invoices, I stopped working with the app and a Lady by the name of Nikki called and asked why don’t I use the app anymore.  I told her that I was promised full access to the app and that was a lie.  So she gave me a phone number to call to complain.  I called  the number and some other company picked up trying to sell me some other stuff.  I texted Nikki and asked her to stop my subscription immediately and refund me.
The next thing I noticed was a charge for $83.94 on my credit card.  I called the number again to get my credit card charge refunded and the same scam company picked up. The next month, another charge for $83.94 was on my credit card.  
I called and put a stop payment from “HOUSECALL PRO”.   I received a call from Hannah asking if there was anything she could do for me and I explained I was unable to get full access to use the app and I was dissatisfied and wanted to cancel and be refunded for the charges.   It has been 3 months now and no one has helped me and I have not been refunded.  And another charge of $83.94 again!  I emailed them and Sharon got back to me anc told me it takes about 24 hours to hear back from us.  Here I am three days later and still no answer and no refund.

I keep  being charged for not using the app and it was supposed to have been cancelled 3 months ago.

Today they told me they denied my refund with no reason.

DO NOT use this app or work with this company!  

With that being said think again if this is the company that you want to manage your business accounts.

reviews.text:
It’s a great software until you have an issue. Has also grown to a size in which their contractual obligations outweigh their customer service procedures. Had an issue recently in which an employee overpaid nearly $1,000 for extra users that weren't in use for us. We rectified as quickly as possible. Housecall was only willing to rebate $90 of the $1,000 that was lost. Our employee swears she wasn’t aware of the proper procedure by which to add and remove users from both their use in the system and from billing.

Whatever the case, Housecall opted to make the extra $900 rather than take care of a 5-year customer. We are also a SuperPro customer and have basically every full service they offer, including a price guide.

In truth, the software is fine, but beware of their customer service. As the company has grown, the service and their willingness to quickly respond to issues has dwindled, and is shameful. 

I’m looking forward to the day we outgrow it and move onto Service Titan. If you can make due with a cheaper software, which is more personal and still fits your business, I recommend doing that. Once you’re signed up, you’ll be trapped. Regardless of a month-to-month agreement with no contract, our entire business hinges on this software. Removing and replacing would take weeks, if not months with more time still needed for us all to adapt.

All in all, I do like the software, just not the people behind it anymore.

Josh

reviews.title: New SPAM platform
reviews.text:
My company has been using Housecall Pro for nearly a year, and our journey with this software has been a mix of efficiency and frustration. For the most part, the platform has served us well, offering convenience and a range of features that genuinely made our daily operations smoother. The interface is mostly intuitive, and the range of functionalities it provides has been beneficial in managing our service calls and customer interactions.

However, our overall positive experience took a significant hit due to an incident that occurred recently. We started receiving spam messages through the platform, which was more than just a minor inconvenience; it disrupted our workflow and raised concerns over security and spam protection measures in place. Expecting support and a prompt solution, we reached out to Housecall Pro's customer support, only to be met with disappointment. The response was dismissive at best, advising us to simply ignore the spam messages without offering any real solution or showing any intent to address the underlying issue. This lack of support and accountability is concerning and reflects poorly on their customer service and how they value their users.

It's disheartening when a company, especially one that provides services to businesses, shows little to no interest in resolving an issue that affects its customers' operations. The response, or lack thereof, from Housecall Pro's customer support was not only unhelpful but also left us feeling neglected and frustrated. It suggests a possible oversight in their system's security measures against spam, which is a significant concern for any business relying on digital tools for their operations.

The incident has led us to reconsider our use of Housecall Pro. While the software itself offers a range of helpful features, the lack of adequate support and action against spam messages is a major drawback. The experience has tarnished our view of the company, and moving forward, we are likely to explore other software options that offer not only good functionality but also reliable customer support.

In conclusion, Housecall Pro has its strengths in terms of features and usability, but this incident has highlighted a critical area where it falls short - customer support and spam protection. A software solution for businesses should not only enhance operational efficiency but also provide reliable support to its users. Unfortunately, based on our recent experience, Housecall Pro has room for improvement in these areas. We hope this feedback will encourage Housecall Pro to take customer concerns more seriously and to strengthen their systems and support services.

reviews.title: Cool app but missing features.
reviews.text:
House call pro is a cool app everything you need in one app but there are some key things they are missing, 

 1st they do not have a reminder text feature a day before we come out to do a job.      (thats a key help for small businesses that do not have a office lady) they only have it for email reminders nowadays people uses more text constantly. we are constantly asking for a simple reminder text feature and they come out with different types of features that really a few businesses really need. 

2nd you can add package options for customers when giving a quote thats really cool but they need to remove the subtotal price after you are giving them all the options the app will add all of option prices together at the bottom which is not good when it adds everything customers are sticker shocked it only should be added when a customer picks a option package. That can’t not be removed. 

3rd when you are sending a invoice or a quote and the customers views it,  it does not notify us or send us a confirmation text the customer has viewed the invoice or quote , again they only have the feature if you have the customers email. 

Housecall pro really need to update their thinking we live in a world that 80% of the people uses text to communicate.

reviews.title: QuickBook Desktop Is Not Accurate
reviews.text:
Considering switching back to Service Titan if these issues can’t be resolved.  
There have been several issues that have not been resolved.
﻿﻿﻿The app management update web services in QBD does not stay checked for automatic. So my bookkeeper needs to run it manually every time. This wouldn't be a big deal to run it manually but with it not constantly running it literally takes 20. 30mins to run each time which wastes so much time during the day.
﻿﻿﻿There is not a check number box in HCP when a check is entered.
﻿﻿﻿When a check payment goes over to QB, the Invoice Number gets put into the check box number. That is obviously incorrect since the invoice number is not a check number. Now we can't search up a check without having to do extra work by deleting the invoice number in the check box to then put the check number in there.
﻿﻿﻿Very Important: There is only 1 Income Account. We need multiple income accounts since we have multiole streams of accounts. We have a service, maintenance, and install for our income that we would like to keep separated. Since we switched over to HCP they have grouped all our income into one Service Income account. That is inaccurate. We switch over from Service Titan and was able to have multiple income accounts. So now comparing this year to the previous years when we were able to have separate accounts, this year is completed inaccurate for the accounts.
All companies have more than 1 income account that should be accurately tracked so this is very upsetting that HCP doesn't have this

None of these issues have gotten resolved and it has affected our work efficiency greatly. We really need a resolution and not the run around of a Pro-Vote or someone getting back to us that never does. It was such a hassle to transfer everything over to HCP and now we have to consider the hassle of having to switch back to Service Titan.
I really hope to hear from someone who can offer a resolution and who understands the importance of the QB accuracy.
